decision.rationale: Reviewed Vanilla, current Culture, VE XML and non-VE source descriptions reveal no credible single-Thing mat with existing bed owner enforced for seating and normal rest. The Culture-owned narrow change uniquely combines behaviors without installing an unrelated broader furniture pack. This only establishes necessity for the scoped gameplay adapter; material/art/product acceptance remain separate gates.
decision.independent_gap: Exactly one physical 1x2 bed supporting both owner-only food Ingest/Comfort and original sleep without global isSittable, a second chair or daily reinstallation.
